what_changed: WTI jumped 6.7% in a day to 102.5 (Brent 107.6) after Saudi East-West pipeline attacks, while XOM barely moved. The 10-year yield reached 4.94 on sticky August CPI with a Fed hike vote next week, and VIX rose to 17.8. Copper fell 5% in a day (FCX -6.6%) and NVDA slipped 2.4%.

oil_gas.why: The oil spike is in the driver and XOM has not followed; no dated XOM catalyst.

gold_miners.why: Yields at a high and Fed-hike odds rising; no concrete reason for a long.

chips.why: Headlines are known or noisy and there is no dated NVDA catalyst.

pharma.why: No LLY-specific news; generic FDA and Medicare headlines only.

copper_uranium.why: The one-day drop has no clear cause; no rebound guess in a stress regime.
